text: The X-ray results you provided clearly show the 'double bubble' sign, which is a critical finding for duodenal atresia, not gastroenteritis. Given the bilious vomiting starting immediately after birth and the family history of pyloric stenosis, I need to rule out other causes. Do you know if there were any polyhydramnios (excess amniotic fluid) during the pregnancy, and was the baby's anus patent upon examination? REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Bilious vomiting. I also have Feeding intolerance, No fever, Vomiting started within first day after birth.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Duodenal Atresia.

The 'double bubble' sign on the X-ray, combined with bilious vomiting immediately after birth and the absence of meconium, confirms a complete obstruction of the duodenum. I will proceed with the ultrasound to rule out associated anomalies, but the clinical picture is classic for this condition.
